Implemented D-17.

- Added shared teardown error collection/raising helpers.
- Request and app-context teardown now runs all callbacks, then its teardown signal, collecting failures.
- Python 3.11+ raises `BaseExceptionGroup`; Python 3.10 raises the first error.
- Context popping now completes request close, app teardown, and context-local reset before re-raising teardown failures.
- Added request/app teardown regression tests, including signal execution and context reset.
